content:
[Thinking]
**Finding antonyms for 'stand out'**

I’m looking for an antonym for the phrase "stand out from," which means to be noticeable or prominent. I think "blend in with" fits well as it conveys the opposite meaning of not standing out. For the other options, while "distinguish from" is similar to "stand out," it actually means to tell apart. Also, "emerge from" means to come out of, and "separate from" means to make separate. So, I’ll go with option A.
[/Thinking]

A) Blend in with

"Stand out from" means to be noticeable or prominent compared with others; "blend in with" means to not be noticeable, to match the surroundings — the opposite.
